title: Apply for CAPS relocation and rental assistance
summary: Find out if you can get financial assistance for relocation and rent if you are an unemployed apprentice moving more than 60km for a new job.
intro:
Unemployed apprentices who've found a new employer in NSW, but will need to relocate more than 60kms in order to continue the apprenticeship, may be able to get financial assistance from the Continuing Apprentices/Trainees Placement Scheme (CAPS).

If you're eligible you can claim relocation and rental assistance.

You must submit your claims within 3 months of the start of your new training contract.
who_can_apply: Have been registered in NSW as an apprentice or new entrant trainee under the Apprenticeship and Traineeship Act 2001
Be unemployed and recommencing your apprenticeship
Be relocating more than 60kms from your previous place of residence in order to continue your apprenticeship
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'CAPS relocation and rental assistance application'
A copy of your rental lease
All receipts relating to your relocation
Your bank account details for payment

how_to_steps.text: Lodge your application using the details on the form.

more_info.text: The relocation allowance is a payment to reimburse your out-of-pocket expenses for the cost of moving house.

The rental allowance covers the costs of a rental bond (equivalent to a maximum of 4 weeks of rent) plus 2 weeks rent. It's not paid until after your new training contract has been approved and registered.
Visit Travel, accommodation and relocation assistance packages for apprentices for more detailed information.

faqs.q: Who can apply for CAPS relocation and rental assistance?
faqs.a: You must be an unemployed apprentice who has been registered in NSW as an apprentice or new entrant trainee under the Apprenticeship and Traineeship Act 2001, registered with CAPS, and relocating more than 60kms from your previous residence to continue your apprenticeship.

faqs.q: How long do I have to submit my claims?
faqs.a: You must submit your claims within 3 months of the start of your new training contract.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need the 'CAPS relocation and rental assistance application' PDF form, a copy of your rental lease, and all receipts related to your relocation, including your bank account details for payment.
